record.dic_text:
4614 Sina {see-nah'}

源自希伯來文 SNH05514; TDNT - 7:282,1026; 專有地名

欽定本 - Sina 2, Sinai 2; 4

西乃 = "多荊棘的"
1) 在阿拉伯彼特拉伊(Petraea)半島中的一座山或是群山區，
   因頒摩西律法而出名
record.edic_text:
4614 Sina {see-nah'}

of Hebrew origin 05514; TDNT - 7:282,1026; n pr loc

AV - Sina 2, Sinai 2; 4

Sinai = "thorny"
1) a mountain or rather a mountainous region in the peninsula of
   Arabia Petraea, made famous by the giving of the Mosaic law
